title: A Turn off refused during a failed erase leaves reminders shown on though the server row is cancelled
evidence: Done 2026-11-14: a Turn off whose write the record refuses (an erase runs) throws ERASE_IN_PROGRESS ('Your data is being deleted. Try again in a moment.', packages/health-core/src/erase.ts), counts no opt-out, and the control shows that message with the switch still on (US-11 AC4b, US-17 AC17). Tests: reminders.test.ts table row 6; reminders-control.test.tsx 'a Turn off refused by an erase in progress'. Was: standalone/reminders.ts:397 ignores setReminderOptIn's false. Turn off pressed, then Delete all my data confirmed while the cancel is out, and the erase fails (its cloud read fails): the write is refused because the session is erasing, the server row is cancelled, but the record and the screen keep reminders on with no error until a later push gets a 404 and flips them (US-11 AC4b residual). Options: read the opt-in again and show the true state, or push again. Found by the PR 1664 adversary
